paṇopaṇaviyā.p: [Paṇaviyā+opaṇaviyā] (thī) CL=8 Rhe့puda of viyā-kiu khye.] quote the price of sth one is selling (or) call a high-price, bargaining (or) haggle over price of goods.
a: ပဏောပဏဝိယာ(ထီ)
[ပဏဝိယာ+ဩပဏဝိယာ။

B:
paṇopaṇaviyā： paṇopaṇaviyā（thī）
ပဏောပဏဝိယာ（ထီ）
[paṇaviyā+opaṇaviyā．eiea viyā- khye．]
[ပဏဝိယာ+ဩပဏဝိယာ။ ရှေ့ပုဒ်၏ ဝိယာ-ကို ချေ။]
K:
paṇopaṇaviyā：ပဏောပဏဝိယာ（ထီ）
[ပဏဝိယာ+ဩပဏဝိယာ။ ရှေ့ပုဒ်၏ ဝိယာ-ကို ချေ။]

[ ts ], a bet, a wager; stipulation; setting a price; wages; wealth, property; trade; Abh 532 (~o ’bbhuto); 908 (~o vittamūlesu vohāre ca dhane); Sp 553, 26 (~aṃ akaṃsu, Be so; Ce, Ee paṇītakaṃ; Se paṇitakaṃ); — paṇā in Ee at Ja IV 488, 23 is prob. wr; read sabbāpaṇā with Be, Ce, Se; — °’- opaṇaviyā , f. , making stipulations and bargaining; M I 480, 28 (evarūpī ~ā na upeti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee paṇopaṇavidhā, prob. wr; Ps III 194, 3 : paṇaviyā ca opaṇaviyā ca … kayavikkayakālo viya agghavaḍḍhanahāpanaṃ na hotī ti attho, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be kayavikkayakāle).
